data.long_description:
Experience refined urban living at Legado by Prescott, a contemporary residential development crafted for those who value comfort, style, and convenience. This spacious 2-bedroom apartment offers an elegant living environment with thoughtfully designed interiors, making it ideal for families, professionals, and investors alike.

Located in one of Dubai's growing residential communities, the development provides easy access to major road networks, business hubs, shopping destinations, schools, and lifestyle attractions. Combining modern architecture with a well-connected location, Legado by Prescott offers an exceptional opportunity to enjoy a vibrant and comfortable lifestyle.

Property Features:
- 2 Bedrooms
- 3 Bathrooms
- 1,543.32 Sq. Ft.
- Open-plan living and dining area
- Contemporary kitchen
- Built-in wardrobes
- Balcony
- Floor-to-ceiling windows
- Laundry room
- Premium finishes
- Covered parking
- Swimming pool
- Fully equipped fitness center
- Children's play area
- Landscaped gardens
- Multi-purpose room
- High-speed elevators
- 24/7 security
- Concierge services
